children: is testing drone delivery in its home market of Charlotte, North Carolina, enabling the home improvement retailer the ability to deliver merchandise in as little as 20 minutes.
Orders can be placed through DoorDash
and will be delivered by Alphabet’s
Wing Aviation drones. The drones can carry orders weighing ~2.5 pounds per flight.

"By piloting drone delivery, we're addressing a real project pain point with an innovative solution that is integrated into the retail journey, giving our hometown customers next-generation fulfillment right when they need it,”
Seemantini Godbole, chief information and AI officer at Lowe’s.
The drone delivery option is the first of its kind within the home improvement space. While rival Home Depot

offers various options for fast delivery—including freight trucks for construction materials—the fastest delivery option is 3 hours or less through its Express Delivery service, although third-party partnerships through Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Instacart can offer faster delivery options.
